```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)
```



```{r}
# All data from Basketball Reference, rookie year (2012-13) up to the 2025-26 season. Every season file is loaded with the same function so they all have identical columns.

load_draymond <- function(file, season) {
  read_csv(file, col_types = cols(.default = col_character()),
           # non-games show up as text in the stat columns
           na = c("", "Did Not Play", "Did Not Dress", "Inactive", "Not With Team", "Player Suspended")) |>
    # the unnamed column is home/away ("@" = away)
    rename(home_away = 6) |>
    # split "W 87-85" into win_loss ("W"), team_score (87), opponent_score (85)
    # (extra = "drop" discards the "(OT)" tag on overtime games)
    separate(Result, into = c("win_loss", "score"), sep = " ", extra = "drop") |>
    separate(score, into = c("team_score", "opponent_score"), sep = "-") |>
    mutate(
      season = season,
      Date = as.Date(Date),
      # minutes played: "15:27" -> 15.45
      MP = period_to_seconds(ms(MP)) / 60,
      across(c(Rk, Gcar, Gtm, team_score, opponent_score, FG:`+/-`), as.numeric)
    )
}

draymond_rookie <- load_draymond("Draymond2012.csv", "2012-13")
```


```{r}
# combine all seasons into one data frame
draymond_all <- bind_rows(
  draymond_rookie, draymond_2013, draymond_2014, draymond_2015, draymond_2016,
  draymond_2017, draymond_2018, draymond_2019, draymond_2020, draymond_2021,
  draymond_2022, draymond_2023, draymond_2024, draymond_2025
)
```


### Task 3: Create a new column called `goal_diff` that calculates the difference between the two teams' goals.

```{r}
draymond_rookie <- draymond_rookie |> mutate(point_diff = team_score - opponent_score)

```

### Task 4: Use `summarize()` and the `cor()` function to calculate the correlation between fouls and goal differential, using the pearson method.

```{r}
draymond_rookie |> summarize(correlation = cor(`3P`, point_diff, use = "complete.obs", method="pearson"))
```

### Task 5: Create a scatterplot of fouls and goal differential, using `geom_point()`

```{r}

draymond_rookie |>
  ggplot() +
  geom_point(aes(x=point_diff, y=`3P`)) +
  geom_smooth(aes(x=point_diff, y=`3P`), method="lm")

```
